description: RFQMind helps sourcing teams find products and certified manufacturers. Search by product, specification, part number, or company; review product cards and company profiles; load more results; and compare alternatives. Open an English inquiry form, add your requirements and optional attachments, review the details, and confirm once to submit. View your submitted inquiries, recorded quotes, and activity updates. An inquiry is an internal RFQMind record for follow-up. RFQMind does not automatically send supplier messages, place orders, or process payments. Submitted inquiries are read-only.
